claims.claim: BepiColombo completed its orbit insertion around Mercury despite a software issue that cut the manoeuvre short.
claims.episode_span: The joint ESA/JAXA spacecraft completed its orbit insertion despite a software issue that cut the manoeuvre short.
claims.source_title: BepiColombo safely in orbit around Mercury
claims.supporting_quote: BepiColombo is safely in orbit around Mercury! Despite a software issue that cut its orbit insertion manoeuvre short, the ESA/JAXA spacecraft is safe and in a stable orbit after an eight-year journey.

claims.claim: Webb mid-infrared data show that interior shells of the Cas A progenitor merged only hours before core collapse.
claims.episode_span: The data indicate that interior shells of the progenitor star merged only hours before core collapse.
claims.source_title: Webb finds evidence star's layers may have merged just hours before Cas A supernova
claims.supporting_quote: Material within these shells churns and circulates, which can cause the shells to merge shortly before the supernova explosion.

claims.claim: The White House is asking Congress for an additional $2 billion for the Artemis Program as part of a FY 2027 continuing resolution.
claims.episode_span: The additional funding would support a higher rate of operations across the programme.
claims.source_title: White House seeks $2B extra for Artemis in CR
claims.supporting_quote: Major win for NASA here as the White House asks Congress for an additional $2 billion as part of a FY 2027 continuing resolution for "a higher rate of operations" with the Artemis Program.

claims.claim: Northrop Grumman has contracted a sixth Falcon 9 launch for its Cygnus resupply spacecraft.
claims.episode_span: The new contract extends reliance on SpaceX while Antares 330 development continues.
claims.source_title: Northrop books sixth Falcon 9 for Cygnus as Antares 330 waits
claims.supporting_quote: Northrop Grumman has contracted a sixth Falcon 9 launch for its Cygnus resupply spacecraft, extending The post Northrop books sixth Falcon 9 for Cygnus as Antares 330 waits appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com.

claims.claim: NG-25 will carry approximately 11,000 pounds of cargo on booster B1096, which is making its ninth flight.
claims.episode_span: NG-25, the next Cygnus flight carrying 11,000 pounds of cargo, remains scheduled for 29 November from Cape Canaveral on booster B1096.
claims.source_title: Northrop books sixth Falcon 9 for Cygnus as Antares 330 waits
claims.supporting_quote: NG-25 is the fifth Cygnus to fly on Falcon 9 since the retirement of the Antares 230+, following NG-20, NG-21, NG-23 and NG-24.

claims.claim: The Europa Clipper documentary covers three decades of work on the 6-ton spacecraft and its 1.8-billion-mile journey.
claims.episode_span: The film follows three decades of work that produced the 6-ton spacecraft now en route to Jupiter’s icy moon.
claims.source_title: New Documentary on Europa Mission on NASA+
claims.supporting_quote: Over three decades, thousands of dedicated minds have poured their expertise, creativity, and persistence into building Europa Clipper, the largest spacecraft NASA has ever engineered and built for a planetary mission.

claims.claim: Russia is keeping details of the routine Progress MS-36 launch secret, with NASA declining to confirm the date during a public briefing.
claims.episode_span: NASA declined to confirm the MS-36 launch date or time during a public briefing.
claims.source_title: Russia will launch a routine ISS supply mission tomorrow—apparently, it's a big secret
claims.supporting_quote: It was the most simple of questions. On Monday afternoon, during a NASA news conference about the International Space Station, Space News reporter Jeff Foust asked about an upcoming launch of a Russian spacecraft.
